help: `!help [command]` - Explains how to use any specific command.
commands: `!commands` - Displays the full administrative and utility directory menu.
prefix: `!prefix [symbol]` - Changes the command trigger prefix symbol on the fly.
warn: `!warn @user [reason]` - Warns a member, deletes your input, and sends a DM embed card.
unwarn: `!unwarn @user [number]` - Removes a specific number of warning strikes from a member.
warns: `!warnings @user` - Audits a member's active warning strike history entries.
clearwarns: `!clearwarns @user` - Completely clears a member's warning strikes back to zero.
mute: `!mute @user [time] [reason]` - Temporarily mutes a user and deletes your input message.
unmute: `!unmute @user` - Instantly unmutes a member. Alerts you if they aren't muted.
kick: `!kick @user [reason]` - Deletes your input, sends a private DM layout card, and kicks them.
ban: `!ban @user [reason]` - Deletes your input, sends a private DM layout card, and bans them permanently.
unban: `!unban [user_id]` - Unbans a member using their unique Discord account ID string.
afk: `!afk [reason]` - Marks you as away. Calculates exactly how long you were gone when you return.
nick: `!nick @user [name]` / `!n` - Overrides a member's server profile nickname instantly.
clearnick: `!clearnick @user` / `!cn` - Wipes a custom nickname back to default values.
serverinfo: `!serverinfo` - Displays clean server statistics along with your server icon picture.
r: `!r add/give/remove @user [role]` - Modifies roles cleanly using smart role name keyword matching.
slowmode: `!slowmode [time]` - Adjusts the chat cooldown slowmode timing in that specific channel.
purge: `!purge [amount]` / `!c` / `!p` - Bulk deletes a specified block of text chat messages.
pus: `!pus @user [no.]` - Purges an exact amount of messages from one specific user only.
say: `!say [message]` - Sends an anonymous message broadcast directly through the bot.
snipe: `!snipe` / `!s` - Recovers the content and author of the most recently deleted message.
cs: `!cs` - Flushes the channel message sniper cache memory clean and adds a checkmark.
es: `!es` - Recovers the original text string state of recently edited messages.
ces: `!ces` - Flushes the edited message cache database completely and adds a checkmark.
ticket: `!ticket name | #hex | Title | Desc` - Spawns a custom Tickety spawner button panel.
closeticket: `!closeticket` / `!ct` - Locks, archives, and deletes an active ticket channel room.
